items.focusIndicatorDescription: A light blue outline appears around the 'Jam dakord' button in the cookie consent banner.
items.issue: The focus indicator, a light blue outline around the 'Jam dakord' button, has insufficient contrast against the button's white background. This makes it difficult for users with low vision or certain color vision deficiencies to perceive the focus, failing WCAG 2.4.11's requirement for a 3:1 contrast ratio for non-text components.
items.suggestion: Enhance the visibility of the focus indicator by using a color with a higher contrast ratio (at least 3:1) against the button's background. Alternatively, consider a more prominent visual change such as a darker, thicker border, a contrasting box shadow, or a background color change upon focus.

visualIssues: The 'Unë nuk jam dakord' button in the cookie consent banner is clipped on the right side, making it not fully visible.
items.suggestion: Ensure all interactive elements, especially buttons, reflow correctly and are fully visible at a 320px viewport width without clipping. Consider stacking buttons vertically or adjusting their sizing/spacing for smaller viewports.

issues: Text content for H2, P, and H3 elements is programmatically detected as clipped when text spacing overrides are applied.
items.suggestion: Ensure that text containers can expand to accommodate increased line height, letter spacing, word spacing, and paragraph margins without clipping content. Use flexible layouts and avoid fixed heights for text-containing elements.
